Analyzing the image:

**Observed features:**
- Close-up of a leaf showing broad yellowing/pale yellow discoloration on the right portion
- Left side retains green coloration; right side transitions to yellow-green/pale yellow
- No distinct circular spots with dark rings (rules out Brown_Eye_Spot, Berry_Blotch)
- No visible pale trail mines in the epidermis (rules out Miner)
- No dark depressed lesions (rules out Phoma)
- Diffuse chlorotic/yellowing pattern across the leaf surface

**Reasoning:**
The prominent yellowing of the leaf tissue is most consistent with **Rust**, which causes yellow spots on upper leaf surfaces associated with orange/yellow powdery lesions below, leading to widespread chlorosis and eventual leaf browning/drop. The broad yellow discoloration visible here matches the rust-induced chlorosis pattern described: "irregular shaped spots on upper leaf surfaces... leaves eventually dry up and turn brown."

Brown_Eye_Spot and Berry_Blotch would show distinct circular spots with dark rings, which are absent. Phoma would show dark depressed lesions. Miner would show trail-like mines. The diffuse yellowing without discrete dark-bordered spots points to Rust.
